title: unix_secs_to_rfc3339 duplicated in kith-peer and kith-store private util
description: kith-peer/src/lib.rs comment explicitly notes it duplicates the algorithm from kith-store's private util module. When a timezone edge-case bug is found, both copies must be fixed. Neither has a cross-validation test. Fix: move to kith-core (which both crates already depend on) as a pub(crate) fn.
